items.title: 〈台股風向球〉資金續航力先看台幣 提防「升息周期到來」的預期形成
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Watch the New Taiwan Dollar's Funding Strength and Guard Against Expectations of an "Interest‑Rate‑Hike Cycle"
paras: 台股過去一周下跌366.28點，多方守住4萬6及月線支撐，隨著美股周五反彈反映國際油價回跌，本周開局的升息恐慌壓力緩解，不過，台股交易員提醒，美國聯準會本周升息機率已超過80%，新台幣若轉弱恐不利資金行情續航，再加上中東政治局勢複雜令油價高度波動，仍須留意系統性風險升溫。此外台積電(2330-TW)將於周三(16日) 進行除息，每股配發現金股利 7元，美國聯準會與台灣央行預計周四(17日) 同日公布最新利率決策，也成為市場關注的焦點。
台股上周終結周線連2紅，儘管跌幅僅0.79%，但除了投信不離不棄，外資和自營商均站在賣超，使籌碼面有壓。
觀察外資上周主要賣超仁寶(2324-TW)達9.8萬張，緯創(3231-TW)8萬張，元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)近7萬張，台新新光金(2887-TW)超過5.8萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)超過4萬張，主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)近3.8萬張，群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)3萬張。
台股交易員表示，CME FedWatch 顯示本周聯準會升息 1 碼的機率已達86%，但美股周五並未明顯反映升息恐慌壓力是因油價回落，部分市場聲浪更認為美國通膨數據尚不足以支撐升息。
因此，本周須留意國際油價的波動大，一旦美國升息並造成市場預期「升息周期已到來」，恐使大盤整體資金回流美元，並造成一波短線的拉回壓力。
永豐投顧分析，台股歷史高原區47000點左右均線糾結，在上周五跌破後要看本周是否可以成功收復，以及量能是否放大，量能若是持續縮小到6000億元，整體市場資金不足，則後續要重新站回關卡需要更多利多推動。
永豐投顧也提醒，市場將開始關注油價影響物價是否已開始形成長期化。
paras_en: The Taiwan market fell 366.28 points last week, with bulls holding the 46,000 level and the monthly moving‑average support. As U.S. equities rebounded on Friday, reflecting a pull‑back in global oil prices, the interest‑rate‑hike panic at the start of this week eased. However, traders warned that the Fed’s probability of raising rates this week has now exceeded 80%; a weakening New Taiwan dollar could hurt the market’s funding stamina. In addition, the complex political situation in the Middle East keeps oil prices highly volatile, raising systemic‑risk concerns. TSMC (2330‑TW) will declare a cash dividend of NT$7 per share on Wednesday (the 16th), and the Fed and Taiwan’s central bank are expected to announce their latest rate decisions on Thursday (the 17th), which will also draw market focus.

Last week the Taiwan market ended a two‑week streak of weekly gains; despite a modest 0.79% decline, institutional investors remained supportive while foreign investors and proprietary traders were net sellers, putting pressure on the chip count.

Foreign investors’ major net‑selling last week included 98,000 shares of Compal (2324‑TW), 80,000 shares of Wistron (3231‑TW), nearly 70,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), over 58,000 shares of Taishin Shin Kong Financial (2887‑TW), more than 40,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Forward 2 (00631L‑TW), about 38,000 shares of Active CTBC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) and 30,000 shares of Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield (00919‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader noted that the CME FedWatch tool shows an 86% chance of a one‑point Fed hike this week, but Friday’s U.S. market did not reflect strong hike‑fear pressure because oil prices fell, and some market voices argue that U.S. inflation data are still insufficient to justify another hike.

Therefore, this week investors should watch for large swings in international oil prices. If the Fed does raise rates and the market perceives that the “rate‑hike cycle has arrived,” capital could flow back to the dollar, creating short‑term pull‑back pressure on the broader index.

Yongfeng Investment Advisory points out that the Taiwan market’s historic plateau around the 47,000‑point moving‑average band has been tangled; after breaking below it last Friday, the key question is whether the market can reclaim the level this week and whether volume expands. If volume continues to shrink to NT$600 billion, overall market liquidity will be thin, and a further rally will need additional positive catalysts.
Yongfeng also cautioned that the market will start watching whether oil‑price‑driven inflation is beginning to become entrenched over the long term.

items.title: imec突破High-NA EUV極限 光阻材料將一路延續至埃米世代
items.title_en: imec Breaks High-NA EUV Limits; Photoresist Materials Expected to Continue Through the A-Series Nodes
paras: 比利時微電子研究中心(imec)宣布攜手ASML及材料供應商，在High-NA EUV微影技術再取得進展。將產業沿用多年的化學放大阻劑(CAR)，完成22奈米間距導線的單次圖形化，並驗證多種接近實際晶片設計的複雜結構，顯示成熟CAR光阻技術有望延伸至A14、A10等埃米世代，應用於部分關鍵金屬層與通孔層。
隨著先進製程持續微縮，傳統0.33NA EUV在部分高密度層已逐步逼近單次曝光極限，未來若要製作更細線路，可能需要透過多重圖形化增加曝光與蝕刻次數。High-NA EUV則藉由提高數值孔徑，提升解析能力，目標是在更小尺寸下仍可維持單次曝光，降低製程複雜度及多次曝光帶來的對位誤差。
不過，曝光機解析度提升後，光阻材料是否能同步支援更細微圖形，一直是High-NA EUV量產的重要挑戰。化學放大阻劑是目前半導體業長期使用的成熟技術，具備穩定度高、供應鏈完整與量產經驗豐富等優勢，但過去業界普遍關注，其在極小尺寸下是否會面臨圖形粗糙、斷線或橋接等問題。
imec此次公布的成果顯示，經過材料與蝕刻製程共同優化後，CAR的微縮能力仍有進一步延伸空間。imec已利用High-NA EUV單次曝光，成功完成22奈米導線/間距圖形，較先前驗證的28奈米間距再進一步縮小。
除了規則性線路外，imec此次也將測試範圍擴展到更貼近實際邏輯晶片的複雜圖形，包括蛇形與叉形電性測試結構、SRAM布局、邏輯金屬佈線，以及28奈米中心間距的通孔結構，並取得良好的圖形保真度。
imec指出，相關成果顯示High-NA EUV搭配CAR，有機會應用在A14、A10邏輯節點的部分關鍵元件層，包括第二金屬層(M2)、通孔層，以及連接電晶體源極、汲極與第一金屬層的金屬擴散層。
事實上，imec先前已透過電性測試，驗證High-NA EUV搭配CAR可製作28奈米間距金屬線，並在長達1.8公尺的金屬化測試結構上取得具發展潛力的組合良率，證明相關技術不只停留在圖形成像階段，也具備進一步朝電性與量產驗證推進的潛力。
此次進一步將間距縮小至22奈米，也代表CAR突破過去0.33NA EUV單次圖形化被認為存在的微縮極限。相較全面更換新型光阻材料，若現有CAR平台可持續沿用，將有助降低High-NA EUV導入新材料與新製程的複雜度，並延續既有成熟供應鏈。
imec圖形化技術研究計畫研發副總Geert Vandenberghe表示，CAR是半導體產業沿用數十年的成熟技術，穩定性及可製造性均已經過長期驗證，最新研究結果顯示，CAR在High-NA EUV時代仍具有相當大的應用價值。
從產業角度來看，High-NA EUV真正的效益不僅在於能夠印出更小尺寸圖形，更在於有機會將原本需要兩次甚至多次曝光的關鍵製程，重新整合為單次圖形化。若能減少曝光、蝕刻與對位次數，可望降低製程複雜度與overlay誤差，並改善先進製程的製造效率。
paras_en: Belgian research institute imec announced a collaboration with ASML and material suppliers to achieve another milestone in High-NA EUV lithography, using the industry‑standard chemically amplified resist (CAR) to print 22 nm pitch lines in a single exposure and to validate a variety of complex structures that resemble real chip designs, indicating that mature CAR technology could extend to A14, A10 and other A‑series nodes for selected critical metal and via layers.

As advanced processes keep shrinking, conventional 0.33 NA EUV is approaching its single‑exposure limit on some high‑density layers, and future finer lines may require multiple patterning steps that increase exposure and etch cycles. High‑NA EUV raises the numerical aperture to improve resolution, aiming to keep single‑exposure printing at smaller dimensions, thereby reducing process complexity and alignment errors associated with multiple exposures.

However, once the scanner’s resolution is enhanced, whether the photoresist can keep up with finer patterns remains a key challenge for High‑NA EUV volume production. Chemically amplified resists are a long‑standing, mature technology in the semiconductor industry, offering high stability, a complete supply chain and extensive production experience, but the industry has traditionally worried about potential issues such as line roughness, breaks or bridges at extremely small dimensions.

imec’s new results show that, after co‑optimizing the resist and etch processes, CAR still has room to shrink further. Using High‑NA EUV single‑exposure, imec successfully printed 22 nm line/space patterns, a step beyond the previously demonstrated 28 nm pitch.

Beyond regular lines, imec also expanded testing to more realistic logic‑chip geometries, including serpentine and forked electrical test structures, SRAM layouts, logic metal routing, and 28 nm center‑to‑center via patterns, all of which achieved good pattern fidelity.

imec notes that these findings suggest High‑NA EUV combined with CAR could be used for key layers of the A14 and A10 logic nodes, such as the second metal layer (M2), via layers, and the metal diffusion layer that connects transistor source/drain to the first metal layer.

In fact, imec previously demonstrated through electrical testing that High‑NA EUV with CAR can fabricate 28 nm pitch metal lines and achieved promising combination yields on a 1.8‑meter‑long metallization test structure, proving the technology is moving beyond imaging to electrical and production validation.

Shrinking the pitch further to 22 nm this time shows that CAR can break the perceived shrink limit of 0.33 NA EUV single‑patterning. If the existing CAR platform can continue to be used instead of switching to entirely new resists, it will lower the complexity of introducing new materials and processes for High‑NA EUV while preserving the mature supply chain.

Geert Vandenberghe, vice‑president of imec’s lithography research program, said CAR has been a proven, decades‑old technology in the semiconductor industry, with stability and manufacturability validated over time, and the latest results demonstrate that CAR still holds significant value in the High‑NA EUV era.

From an industry perspective, the real benefit of High‑NA EUV lies not only in printing smaller features but also in the possibility of consolidating processes that previously required two or more exposures into a single patterning step. Reducing the number of exposures, etches and alignments can cut process complexity and overlay errors, improving manufacturing efficiency for advanced nodes.

items.title: 葉門戰局升溫牽動全球航運！胡塞若擴大控制恐衝擊紅海運輸
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝持續擴大軍事推進，美軍高層據報赴沙烏地協調，引發外界對葉門戰局及紅海航運安全的關注。相關分析認為，若胡塞進一步控制葉門全境，可能牽動曼德海峽、沙烏地安全及伊朗區域影響力，但其能否最終統一葉門仍存在高度不確定性。
葉門胡塞武裝近期持續擴大在葉門境內的軍事推進，引發外界對其進一步擴大控制範圍的關注。根據美國中央司令部（CENTCOM）及多家媒體在2026年9月11日至12日的消息，美軍中央司令部司令庫珀（Brad Cooper）上將據報已前往沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅得，另有逾100名美軍高級軍事顧問前往當地協調。
在胡塞武裝近期向葉門西南部及曼德海峽方向推進之際，美軍高層赴沙烏地的動向，也讓外界更加關注美國、沙烏地與胡塞武裝之間的下一步行動。
相關分析認為，如果胡塞武裝進一步擊敗葉門政府軍及南方派系，最終取得對葉門大部分甚至全境的控制，其影響將不僅限於葉門內戰，也可能牽動紅海、亞丁灣及國際航運安全。
不過，胡塞武裝能否最終統一葉門，以及其是否有能力長期控制全國，目前仍屬未確定情勢。以下部分影響則是原文根據胡塞若進一步擴大控制所提出的推演。

胡塞若擴大控制　紅海航運風險受關注

相關分析首先將焦點放在國際航運。
葉門位處紅海與亞丁灣交界一帶，若胡塞武裝進一步擴大對葉門沿海地區的控制，其對紅海及亞丁灣航運的影響力也可能隨之增加。
原文認為，如果胡塞最終控制葉門全境，將使其掌握更大範圍的紅海沿岸、亞丁灣北岸及相關港口與島嶼，進而對經由蘇伊士運河、紅海及亞丁灣的國際航運產生更直接的影響。
這條航線連接亞洲、歐洲與中東，是全球重要的海上貿易通道。原文指出，蘇伊士運河—紅海—亞丁灣航線約承擔全球12%的貿易量及30%的貨櫃運輸量，因此任何一方若能大幅提高對該區域的軍事控制能力，都可能使航運業者面臨更高的安全風險。
原文進一步推演，胡塞武裝若控制馬雲島（Perim Island）、亞丁（Aden）及穆卡拉（Mukalla）等戰略位置，並在沿海地區部署飛彈設施與其他軍事據點，可能具備更強的海上拒止能力。
按照這項分析，胡塞未來可能利用船舶通行作為政治與外交工具，對不同國家的商船採取差異化政策。
原文甚至推測，若胡塞武裝完全掌控葉門，可能對不符合其外交立場的國家施加航運限制，進而推高全球航運成本與保險費率。

沙烏地面臨葉門戰局重新洗牌

胡塞武裝若持續擴大控制，也可能改變沙烏地阿拉伯在葉門問題上的戰略處境。
沙烏地長期介入葉門衝突，並支持葉門政府及其他反胡塞勢力。原文認為，如果胡塞最終擊敗葉門政府軍及南方勢力，沙烏地過去在葉門投入的軍事與政治資源將面臨重大考驗。
相關分析因此推測，沙烏地可能被迫重新評估與胡塞武裝的關係，包括是否接受胡塞在首都薩那（Sanaa）的實際統治地位，甚至透過談判換取沙烏地本土及能源設施的安全。
原文特別提到，胡塞武裝過去曾對沙烏地境內目標發動攻擊，因此如果其進一步取得葉門沿海及境內更廣泛的控制權，沙烏地可能更重視降低胡塞對其能源基礎設施及領土發動攻擊的風險。
在這種情境下，原文認為沙烏地可能尋求與胡塞達成某種安全安排，以換取能源設施及海上運輸安全。

伊朗影響力與荷姆茲、曼德兩大海峽

原文另一項重要論述，是胡塞武裝與伊朗之間的關係，以及葉門地理位置可能帶來的戰略影響。
相關分析認為，若胡塞取得葉門全境控制權，伊朗在中東的地緣政治影響力可能進一步受到關注。
其中一個核心原因，是葉門鄰近曼德海峽，而伊朗本身則位於荷姆茲海峽周邊。
荷姆茲海峽連接波斯灣與阿曼灣，是中東石油運輸的重要通道；曼德海峽則位於紅海與亞丁灣之間，是連接紅海與印度洋的重要航道。
原文因此將兩條海峽視為伊朗及其盟友可能影響區域能源與航運安全的重要地理節點，並認為若胡塞進一步控制葉門，可能讓伊朗在中東兩端的重要海上通道附近都擁有更大的戰略籌碼。
這也使沙烏地、阿拉伯聯合大公國及其他波斯灣國家面臨新的安全考量。

胡塞若統一葉門　美國與西方影響力恐受考驗

原文同時把胡塞武裝若完成葉門統一視為美國及以色列在紅海地區影響力的一項重大考驗。
胡塞武裝長期與美國及以色列處於對立狀態。若一個與伊朗關係密切、且長期遭美國及其他國家視為威脅的武裝組織，最終能夠從葉門內戰中取得全國性的政治與軍事控制，勢必對區域權力平衡產生影響。
原文認為，這可能被其他採取非對稱作戰方式的武裝組織視為一項訊號，即便面對具備空中力量、海軍力量及高科技軍事裝備的國家，地方武裝仍可能依靠無人機、飛彈及地形優勢維持長期抵抗。

胡塞取得實際控制後　國際社會面臨外交難題

如果胡塞武裝最終取得葉門全境實際控制權，另一個問題將是國際社會如何與薩那當局互動。
原文認為，一旦胡塞成為葉門實際上的唯一主要統治力量，國際社會可能面臨一項現實問題：即使部分國家不認同胡塞的政治立場，仍可能基於商船通行、能源運輸及地區安全等因素，與胡塞控制的當局展開接觸。
相關分析因此推測，部分歐洲國家、區域大國及國際航運相關國家可能逐步與胡塞展開直接對話，以確保商船能夠安全通過紅海及曼德海峽。
原文甚至認為，若胡塞能長期維持對葉門全境的實際控制，國際社會最終可能面臨「務實承認」的壓力。

馬雲島成紅海戰略要點

在原文的軍事推演中，馬雲島是另一個被特別強調的戰略位置。
馬雲島位於曼德海峽，鄰近連接紅海與亞丁灣的重要航道。原文認為，該島的位置使其具備重要的海上交通監控與軍事價值。
相關分析指出，如果胡塞武裝有充足時間在島上建立地下掩體、彈藥庫及永久性防禦工事，未來任何試圖透過軍事手段奪取該島的行動，都可能面臨更高成本。
原文進一步描述，馬雲島地形包含火山岩地貌，且適合兩棲部隊登陸的海灘有限，因此若防禦方能建立固定工事，進攻方可能面臨較大的軍事風險。
按照原文的推演，胡塞武裝可能將反裝甲飛彈及無人機部署於掩體內，在遭到攻擊時進行短時間打擊後迅速撤回掩體，以降低遭到空襲或砲擊摧毀的風險。
這也是原文認為馬雲島可能成為未來紅海軍事競爭焦點的主要原因。

美軍介入程度成關鍵變數

隨著胡塞武裝持續推進，美國是否進一步介入葉門局勢，將成為重要變數。
原文認為，美國及其盟友若要阻止胡塞進一步鞏固對葉門沿海地區的控制，可能必須在其建立更完整防禦體系前採取行動。
其中，馬雲島被原文視為可能具有高度戰略價值的目標，原因在於其位於曼德海峽航道附近。
另一方面，原文指出，美國及以色列在軍事行動上也必須考量人員傷亡、政治成本及長期部署所需的資源。
在胡塞武裝近期快速推進的背景下，原文引述消息稱，沙烏地王儲穆罕默德・本・薩勒曼（Mohammed bin Salman）9月10日曾兩度致電美國總統川普，要求美方直接對胡塞武裝發動軍事打擊，以阻止胡塞在葉門西部的進一步推進。
相關消息稱，白宮並未同意直接採取軍事行動，但可能向沙烏地提供情報及目標識別等支援。
整體而言，胡塞武裝近期在葉門境內的快速推進，已讓葉門內戰與紅海航運、沙烏地安全及伊朗區域影響力等議題進一步交織。
若胡塞未來能夠持續擴大控制範圍，其對曼德海峽周邊航運及區域權力平衡的影響值得持續觀察；但其能否最終統一葉門，以及美國、沙烏地及其他區域國家將採取何種應對措施，目前仍存在高度不確定性。

items.title: 百容購新廠建地本周完成交割 仍往需求強烈半導體應用擴張
items.title_en: BaiRong Completes New Factory Land Transfer This Week, Continues Strong Demand for Semiconductor Applications Expansion
paras: 百容 (2483-TW)擲3.23 億元購置台中工業區工一路702坪廠房及土地，預計在本周完成交割，這也是今年以來繼大立光 (3008-TW) 在台中工業區的提供生產用生產用不動產購置案。百容規劃將爲生產CPU散熱片生產新產能。
百容投資台中廠二期工程已經進入完工階段，二廠並並設置新研發中心；購置台中工業區新廠土地面積達 702 坪，預計將另投入資金購買設備及另重新與建廠房容納重型沖壓設備進駐，對於資金需求規劃，百容評估仍以有資金支應，目前暫無自市場進行籌資的規劃。
百容 2026 年第二季單季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，季增 17.62%，年增 20.42%，同時，在百容第二季在毛利率及營業利益同步走高，加上業外及匯率等有利因素挹注，百容所獲挹注上半年稅後純益將逾 4362萬元，每股純益達 0.4元。
百容 2026 年 7 月營收 2.01 億元，月增 1.75%，年增 37.19%，8月也在1.88億元的歷史高檔水準，且在產品結構上，對半導體應用業務仍維持於50%之上的水準；預估2026年第三季仍將維持第二季的營收水準 。
百容產品涵蓋半導體應用業業、電子零組件、步進馬達等，2026年以來半導體應用業務己登上營收50%之上，同時，對繼電器也朝耐高壓、大電流產品發展。
paras_en: BaiRong (2483-TW) spent NT$323 million to acquire a 702-ping factory and land on Gongyi Road in the Taichung Industrial Zone, with the transfer expected to be completed this week. This follows Largan Precision (3008-TW)’s acquisition of production‑use real estate in the same zone earlier this year. BaiRong plans to use the site to add new capacity for manufacturing CPU heat sinks.

The second‑phase project for BaiRong’s Taichung plant has entered the completion stage and will also house a new R&D center. The newly purchased land totals 702 ping, and the company intends to invest further funds to buy equipment and construct facilities capable of accommodating heavy‑press machines. Regarding financing, BaiRong assesses that it has sufficient internal funds and currently has no plans to raise capital from the market.

In Q2 2026, BaiRong recorded quarterly revenue of NT$566 million, a record high for the period, up 17.62% quarter‑over‑quarter and 20.42% year‑over‑year. Gross margin and operating profit both improved, and favorable non‑operating and exchange‑rate effects boosted the results. The company’s net profit after tax for the first half of the year is projected to exceed NT$43.62 million, or earnings of NT$0.40 per share.

In July 2026, BaiRong’s revenue reached NT$201 million, up 1.75% month‑over‑month and 37.19% year‑over‑year. August revenue remained at a historic high of NT$188 million, and the semiconductor‑application segment continues to account for over 50% of sales. The company expects Q3 2026 revenue to stay at the same level as Q2.

BaiRong’s product portfolio includes semiconductor‑application components, electronic parts, and stepper motors. Since 2026, semiconductor‑application sales have exceeded 50% of total revenue, and the firm is also expanding its relay business toward high‑voltage, high‑current products.

items.title: 中東戰火升溫油價飆破115美元！中油淚吞近2百億 明起汽、柴油各漲0.7元及0.6元
items.title_en: Middle East conflict heats up, oil prices surge past $115! CPC Corp swallows nearly NT$20 billion, gasoline and diesel to rise NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 starting tomorrow
paras: 中東地緣政治危機加劇，國際油價飆漲，即令台灣中油公司近7個月來已吞下近200億補貼，但仍擋不住漲勢。 台灣中油12日宣布，自明（14）日凌晨0時起至9月20日24時止，汽、柴油價格每公升將分別調漲0.7元及0.6元。調整後的參考零售價格分別為92無鉛汽油每公升31.2元、95無鉛汽油每公升32.7元、98無鉛汽油每公升34.7元、超級柴油每公升29.9元。
隨著中東戰事持續升溫，市場對原油供應與運輸風險的疑慮大幅增加，帶動國際油價急遽攀升。台灣中油表示，本周浮動油價調整指標7D3B（70%杜拜+30%北海布蘭特）周均價攀升至每桶115.61美元，較前周的99.82美元大漲15.79美元；雖然新台幣對美元匯率升值0.126元，但綜合評估後，依油價公式計算漲幅仍高達12.29%。

為照顧國內民生與平穩物價，政府及台灣中油持續啟動各項平穩機制。除了政府擴大貨物稅減徵，汽、柴油分別吸收3.7元及2.1元外，台灣中油為維持亞鄰最低價並持續執行美伊戰爭專案平穩機制，本周汽、柴油各再吸收6.8元及8.7元。合計汽、柴油每公升分別吸收高達10.5元及10.8元，大幅緩解國內物價通膨壓力。台灣中油統計，自今年2月28日至9月13日止，執行專案平穩各項措施累計吸收金額已達約198.5億元。
paras_en: The escalating geopolitical crisis in the Middle East has driven international oil prices sharply higher, forcing Taiwan’s CPC Corp to absorb nearly NT$20 billion in subsidies over the past seven months, yet it cannot stop the upward trend. CPC announced on the 12th that, effective from 00:00 on the 14th until 24:00 on September 20, gasoline and diesel prices will each increase by NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 per litre, respectively. After the adjustment, the reference retail prices will be NT$31.2 per litre for 92‑octane unleaded gasoline, NT$32.7 for 95‑octane, NT$34.7 for 98‑octane, and NT$29.9 for premium diesel.

As the Middle East war intensifies, market concerns over crude supply and transportation risks have surged, pushing international oil prices sharply upward. CPC reported that this week’s floating oil price adjustment index 7D3B (70% Dubai + 30% Brent) rose to a weekly average of $115.61 per barrel, up $15.79 from the previous week’s $99.82. Although the New Taiwan dollar appreciated by NT$0.126 against the US dollar, the calculated price increase based on the oil‑price formula still reaches 12.29%.

To protect domestic livelihoods and stabilize prices, the government and CPC continue to activate various stabilization mechanisms. In addition to the government’s expanded reduction of commodity taxes, CPC absorbs NT$3.7 per litre of gasoline and NT$2.1 per litre of diesel. Moreover, to maintain the lowest regional price and continue the US‑Iran war stabilization project, CPC absorbs an additional NT$6.8 per litre of gasoline and NT$8.7 per litre of diesel this week. In total, CPC absorbs up to NT$10.5 per litre of gasoline and NT$10.8 per litre of diesel, markedly easing domestic inflation pressure. CPC’s statistics show that from February 28 to September 13 this year, the cumulative amount absorbed through the stabilization measures totals approximately NT$19.85 billion.

items.title: 引資釋利多！財政部放寬促參公建門檻 勞工與文教設施享5年免營所稅
items.title_en: Attracting Capital, Boosting Benefits: Finance Ministry Lowers Thresholds for Private Participation in Public Projects, Granting 5‑Year Corporate Income Tax Exemption for Labor and Cultural Facilities
paras: 財政部於11日發布修正促進民間參與公共建設法之重大公共建設範圍，針對勞工福利設施及文教設施進行門檻放寬與增訂。本次修法主要為配合勞動部與文化部相關政策，期望藉由誘因吸引更多民間資金投入公共建設興建與營運，除了大幅提升對勞工服務之量能與品質外，也能進一步促進歷史建築與文化資產之永續營運及再利用。
本次重大範圍修正重點主要包含兩大面向。在勞工福利設施部分，增訂依促參法第8條第1項第1款新建營運移轉以及第2款新建無償移轉營運辦理之個案，只要投資總額不含土地達3億元以上之勞工育樂機構及其設施，即可納入重大公共建設範疇，引進民間活力挹注相關設施。
在文教設施部分，考量文化資產活化之特殊性，本次特別增訂投資總額不含土地達5000萬元以上之歷史建築、紀念建築、聚落建築群及文化景觀等設施，希望有效降低民間業者參與門檻，顯著提升民間企業參與文化資產保存、維護及經營管理之意願。

財政部指出，凡符合重大公共建設範圍之促參個案，民間機構將可獲得多項極具吸引力之稅賦優惠措施，包括享有5年免徵營利事業所得稅、投資支出之營利事業所得稅抵減、進口機具設備關稅優惠，以及地價稅、房屋稅與契稅減免，甚至包含股東投資抵減等好處。政府期盼經由本次促參重大範圍之彈性調整，能有效引導民間資金投入相關公共建設計畫，共同打造勞工福祉與文化資產保存雙贏之局面。有關本次修正之詳細規定與內容，民眾及業者可逕至財政部主管法規查詢系統進行深入了解。
paras_en: On the 11th, the Finance Ministry announced revisions to the scope of major public construction under the Act on Promoting Private Participation in Public Works, easing thresholds and adding provisions for labor‑welfare and cultural‑education facilities. The amendment aligns with policies of the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Culture, aiming to attract more private capital into the construction and operation of public projects, thereby greatly enhancing the capacity and quality of services for workers and further promoting the sustainable operation and reuse of historic buildings and cultural assets.

The key changes focus on two areas. For labor‑welfare facilities, the amendment adds new cases under Article 8, Paragraph 1, Items 1 and 2 of the Private Participation Act—newly built facilities transferred for operation and newly built facilities transferred free of charge for operation. Any labor recreation institution and its facilities with a total investment (excluding land) of NT$300 million or more will now be classified as major public construction, opening the door for private sector involvement.

For cultural‑education facilities, recognizing the special nature of cultural‑asset revitalization, the amendment specifically adds historic buildings, memorial structures, settlement clusters and cultural landscapes with total investment (excluding land) of NT$50 million or more. This aims to lower the entry barrier for private firms and significantly increase their willingness to participate in the preservation, maintenance and management of cultural assets.

The Finance Ministry noted that private entities participating in projects that fall within the revised major public‑construction scope will enjoy a suite of attractive tax incentives, including a five‑year exemption from corporate income tax, deductions for corporate income tax on investment expenditures, preferential import duties on machinery and equipment, and reductions or exemptions on land tax, house tax, deed tax, as well as shareholder investment deductions. The government hopes that these flexible adjustments will effectively channel private capital into relevant public‑construction plans, creating a win‑win situation for labor welfare and cultural‑asset preservation. Detailed regulations and provisions of the amendment can be consulted through the Finance Ministry’s regulatory database.

items.title: 台股Q4攻堅有靠山！法人力挺「AI+金融」雙引擎 高息ETF成避風港
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks’ Q4 Push Backed by Institutional Support! Institutions Favor “AI+Finance” Dual Engines, High‑Yield ETFs as Safe Havens
paras: 時序即將步入2026年第四季，台股大盤在歷經第三季高檔拉回洗牌後，整體多頭架構依然穩固。市場法人認為，在全球貨幣政策轉趨寬鬆與AI基礎建設需求熱絡的加持下，台股第四季將迎來傳統旺季與作帳行情。投資人在面對高檔震盪時，可透過布局兼具「AI成長動能」與「金融防禦高息」的高股息ETF，以定期定額或逢回加碼的策略穩健參與第四季攻堅行情。
大華優利高填息30(00918-TW)經理人郭修誠指出，全球金融市場流動性顯著改善，壓低企業資金成本，同時帶動外資回流亞太高成長市場。隨第四季進入傳統科技新品備貨與消費旺季，美系四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI基礎建設資本支出，供應鏈接單能見度已直通2027年。此外，次世代 AI PC 與智慧型手機普及率提升，亦帶動IC通路與消費電子板塊補漲。
非電族群方面，金融業受惠於前三季資本利得與手續費收入爆發，全年獲利有望創歷史新高；航運與重電基建則因運價支撐及全球轉型需求發揮防禦效果。郭修誠分析，00918配置呈現「電腦周邊與AI終端、金融保險、航運物流及電子通路」四足鼎立形態，交叉佈局「AI終端量產＋高息防禦＋基礎建設」，能有效發揮分散風險與提高組合填息率的效果，是高檔拉回時進行戰略性佈局的利器。
針對台股後市，國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)經理人江宇騰表示，台灣AI產業已從題材逐步轉化為實質訂單與企業獲利。財政部最新公布8月出口達824億美元，創歷年單月新高且連續34個月正成長，AI及高效能運算需求即為核心推手。金融業則受惠獲利強勁，國內13家金控前7月合計大賺4,927億元，基本面穩健並具高殖利率優勢。
00878整體配置約四成AI、三成金融，主要成分股涵蓋中信金、廣達、國泰金、富邦金、聯發科與光寶科等指標大廠，近1年報酬率高達80.83%，績效位居高股息ETF第一。國泰投信建議，面對台股高檔震盪，投資人可採取「定期定額、逢回加碼」雙軌策略，透過建立紀律投資機制與股息再投入，平均持有成本並發揮長期複利效果。
在市場波動加大之際，元大台灣高息低波(00713-TW) 的低波動特性備受法人肯定。法人分析，00713主要從台股中大型權值企業中，篩選高股利與低波動標的，統計至7月底，近三年年化波動度僅11.09%，持續居台灣大型股票基金之冠。

下半年以來截至9/11，台股大盤僅小漲0.13%，但00713卻逆勢大漲6.06%。表現勝過大盤的主因，在於上半年電子股漲幅較大後，00713持股自然轉向「電信、金融及內需消費」三大產業並重，例如華南金、永豐金、東和鋼鐵及遠傳、台灣大哥大等皆提供穩健撐盤力道。00713本季公告配息1.25元，將於9/21除息、10/13發放。法人指出，面對市場暴漲暴跌，投資人可將低波動ETF作為現金替代部位，平日領息增益，遭遇拉回時再適度加碼市值型或槓桿型ETF。

paras_en: The calendar is about to enter the fourth quarter of 2026, and after the high‑level pull‑back and reshuffling in Q3, the overall bullish structure of the Taiwan stock market remains solid. Institutional investors believe that with global monetary policy turning more accommodative and strong demand for AI infrastructure, Taiwan’s market will enjoy a traditional peak season and a “account‑closing” rally in Q4. When faced with high‑level volatility, investors can steadily participate in the Q4 push by allocating to high‑dividend ETFs that combine “AI growth momentum” with “financial defensive high yields,” using systematic‑investment or buy‑on‑dip strategies.

Dahua‑Uli’s high‑yield ETF 30 (00918‑TW) manager Guo Xiucheng noted that global financial market liquidity has improved markedly, lowering corporate financing costs and prompting foreign capital to flow back into high‑growth Asia‑Pacific markets. As Q4 brings the traditional tech product‑stock‑piling and consumer peak season, the four major U.S. cloud service providers continue to expand AI infrastructure capex, with supply‑chain order visibility extending to 2027. Moreover, the rising penetration of next‑generation AI PCs and smartphones is boosting IC distribution and consumer‑electronics sectors.

In non‑technology sectors, the financial industry benefits from a surge in capital‑gain and fee income in the first three quarters, positioning full‑year profit to hit a historic high; shipping and heavy‑electric infrastructure gain defensive strength from freight‑rate support and global transition demand. Guo explains that 00918’s allocation forms a “four‑leg” structure of computer peripherals & AI endpoints, financial insurance, shipping logistics, and electronic distribution, crossing “AI endpoint mass production + high‑yield defense + infrastructure.” This diversifies risk and raises the portfolio’s yield‑filling rate, making it a strategic tool for positioning during high‑level pull‑backs.

Regarding Taiwan’s market outlook, Jiang Yuteng, manager of the Cathay Sustainable High‑Dividend ETF (00878‑TW), said Taiwan’s AI industry has moved from a hype theme to real orders and corporate earnings. The Ministry of Finance recently reported August exports of US$82.4 billion, a record monthly high and 34 consecutive months of growth, driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand. The financial sector also benefits from strong earnings, with Taiwan’s 13 banking groups posting a combined profit of NT$492.7 billion in the first seven months, offering solid fundamentals and high dividend yields.

The 00878 fund is roughly 40% AI and 30% financials, with top holdings including CTBC Financial Holding, Quanta Computer, Cathay Financial Holding, Fubon Financial Holding, MediaTek and Lite‑On Technology, delivering a 1‑year return of 80.83%—the best performance among high‑dividend ETFs. Cathay Asset Management recommends that amid high‑level market swings, investors adopt a dual approach of systematic purchases and buying on dips, establishing disciplined investing and dividend reinvestment to lower average cost and harness long‑term compounding.

Amid heightened market volatility, the low‑volatility characteristic of Yuanta Taiwan High‑Yield Low‑Volatility ETF (00713‑TW) has earned strong institutional endorsement. Analysts note that 00713 selects high‑dividend, low‑volatility stocks from Taiwan’s large‑cap weightings; as of the end of July, its three‑year annualized volatility was only 11.09%, consistently the lowest among Taiwan’s large‑cap stock funds.

Since the second half of the year up to September 11, the Taiwan market index has risen a modest 0.13%, while 00713 surged 6.06% against the trend. The outperformance stems from a shift after a strong first‑half rally in electronics toward a balanced exposure to telecom, finance and domestic consumption, with holdings such as Hua Nan Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Donghe Steel, Far EasTone and Taiwan Mobile providing solid support. 00713 announced a quarterly dividend of NT$1.25, ex‑dividend on September 21 and payable on October 13. Institutions suggest that in volatile markets, investors can use low‑volatility ETFs as a cash‑substitute, collect regular income, and add to market‑cap or leveraged ETFs on pull‑backs.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone 18系列與首款摺疊機亮相 台灣手機通路全力備戰預購潮
items.title_en: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Series and First Foldable Phone, Taiwan Retailers Gear Up for Pre‑order Surge
paras: 蘋果正式推出年度旗艦iPhone 18 Pro系列與首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo，台灣各大手機通路商於全面展開預購備戰行動。包含神腦(2450-TW)、燦坤(2430-TW)等業者，啟動線上線下預約機制，藉由信用卡現折、配件加碼以及舊換新補貼等多元配套，力抗零組件成本上漲帶來的終端價格壓力，全力搶攻下半年傳統消費電子換機大潮。
研調機構TrendForce預估，2026年全球摺疊手機出貨量約2020萬支，年增0.5%。其中蘋果iPhone Duo全年度出貨量預計達約500萬支，有望一舉拿下摺疊市場24.8%的市占率，緊追三星的35.1%與華為的24.8%。
研調機構Counterpoint Research進一步指出，受惠於A20 Pro晶片效能升級與強大的既有用戶基礎，iPhone 18 Pro系列對使用3至4年前舊機種的數百萬用戶具備高度升級誘因，加上iPhone Duo定價落在1999美元且未突破2000美元大關，皆有助於刺激初期高階換機需求。
神腦國際宣布於9月12日晚間8時起在線上商城開放iPhone 18 Pro系列預購，祭出全系列機型3%神腦幣無上限回饋，並鎖定10月23日正式開賣的摺疊機iPhone Duo提前卡位。針對換機週期拉長且暫不購置新機的消費族群，採取新機搭售與舊機升級雙軌策略鞏固客戶基礎。
燦坤則宣布，將於9月12日晚間8時在官方線上購物開放iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max預購，並保證9月18日開賣首日即可至全台100家門市取貨，並透露門市現場以新色勃根地紅詢問度最高。
連鎖通訊通路傑昇通信則推出預約抽獎與配件3折優惠，並針對下架的iPhone 17 Pro系列空機擴大降價近4000元出清，同時聯手安卓陣營祭出熱銷旗艦折扣，正面迎戰新機漲勢。
受到全球供應鏈成本與關鍵零組件價格顯著上揚影響，新旗艦機價格面臨調整壓力，前代iPhone 17系列售價同步漲幅超過1成。在量縮價漲的市場氛圍下，通路商轉向藉由分期零利率、高額配件搭售金與延長保固維修等周邊服務，積極降低消費者的換機門檻，並透過提高平均客單價與服務附加價值，全力支撐下半年旺季的整體營運動能。
paras_en: Apple officially launched its annual flagship iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, prompting major Taiwanese mobile retailers to roll out full‑scale pre‑order campaigns. Companies such as Shin Kong (2450‑TW) and Tsann Kuen (2430‑TW) have activated both online and offline reservation systems, offering credit‑card cash‑back, accessory bundles and trade‑in subsidies to counteract the price pressure from rising component costs and to capture the second‑half consumer‑electronics upgrade wave.

Research firm TrendForce estimates global foldable‑phone shipments will reach about 20.2 million units in 2026, a 0.5% year‑over‑year increase. Apple’s iPhone Duo is projected to ship roughly 5 million units for the full year, potentially securing a 24.8% share of the foldable market, closely trailing Samsung’s 35.1% and Huawei’s 24.8%.

Counterpoint Research adds that the A20 Pro chip’s performance boost and Apple’s massive existing user base give the iPhone 18 Pro series a strong upgrade incentive for the millions of users still on devices three to four years old. The iPhone Duo’s price of $1,999—just under the $2,000 mark—should also help drive early high‑end replacement demand.

Shin Kong International announced that starting at 8 p.m. on September 12 it will open pre‑orders for the iPhone 18 Pro series on its online mall, offering an unlimited 3% Shin Kong Coin rebate on all models and reserving the foldable iPhone Duo for early purchase ahead of its official launch on October 23. For customers whose upgrade cycles are longer or who are not yet buying a new phone, the retailer will employ a dual strategy of bundling new devices with trade‑in upgrades to solidify its customer base.

Tsann Kuen said it will open pre‑orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max at 8 p.m. on September 12 via its official online store, guaranteeing that customers can pick up their phones at any of its 100 stores nationwide on the first day of sales, September 18, and noted that the new Burgundy Red color is generating the highest in‑store interest.

Jie Sheng Communications, a chain telecom retailer, launched a reservation lottery and a 30% discount on accessories, while slashing the price of discontinued iPhone 17 Pro bare units by nearly NT$4,000. It also teamed up with Android brands to offer hot‑selling flagship discounts, directly confronting the price hikes of the new models.

Because global supply‑chain costs and key component prices have risen sharply, the new flagship’s pricing faces upward pressure, with the previous‑generation iPhone 17 series seeing price increases of over 10%. In a market of shrinking volumes and rising prices, retailers are turning to zero‑interest installment plans, high‑value accessory bundles, and extended warranty services to lower the barrier for consumers to upgrade, while boosting average transaction value and service‑related revenue to sustain overall operational momentum for the busy second half of the year.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉資金續航力先看台幣 提防「升息周期到來」的預期形成
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Watch the New Taiwan Dollar's Funding Strength and Guard Against Expectations of an "Interest‑Rate‑Hike Cycle"
paras: 台股過去一周下跌366.28點，多方守住4萬6及月線支撐，隨著美股周五反彈反映國際油價回跌，本周開局的升息恐慌壓力緩解，不過，台股交易員提醒，美國聯準會本周升息機率已超過80%，新台幣若轉弱恐不利資金行情續航，再加上中東政治局勢複雜令油價高度波動，仍須留意系統性風險升溫。此外台積電(2330-TW)將於周三(16日) 進行除息，每股配發現金股利 7元，美國聯準會與台灣央行預計周四(17日) 同日公布最新利率決策，也成為市場關注的焦點。
台股上周終結周線連2紅，儘管跌幅僅0.79%，但除了投信不離不棄，外資和自營商均站在賣超，使籌碼面有壓。
觀察外資上周主要賣超仁寶(2324-TW)達9.8萬張，緯創(3231-TW)8萬張，元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)近7萬張，台新新光金(2887-TW)超過5.8萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)超過4萬張，主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)近3.8萬張，群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)3萬張。
台股交易員表示，CME FedWatch 顯示本周聯準會升息 1 碼的機率已達86%，但美股周五並未明顯反映升息恐慌壓力是因油價回落，部分市場聲浪更認為美國通膨數據尚不足以支撐升息。
因此，本周須留意國際油價的波動大，一旦美國升息並造成市場預期「升息周期已到來」，恐使大盤整體資金回流美元，並造成一波短線的拉回壓力。
永豐投顧分析，台股歷史高原區47000點左右均線糾結，在上周五跌破後要看本周是否可以成功收復，以及量能是否放大，量能若是持續縮小到6000億元，整體市場資金不足，則後續要重新站回關卡需要更多利多推動。
永豐投顧也提醒，市場將開始關注油價影響物價是否已開始形成長期化。
paras_en: The Taiwan market fell 366.28 points last week, with bulls holding the 46,000 level and the monthly moving‑average support. As U.S. equities rebounded on Friday, reflecting a pull‑back in global oil prices, the interest‑rate‑hike panic at the start of this week eased. However, traders warned that the Fed’s probability of raising rates this week has now exceeded 80%; a weakening New Taiwan dollar could hurt the market’s funding stamina. In addition, the complex political situation in the Middle East keeps oil prices highly volatile, raising systemic‑risk concerns. TSMC (2330‑TW) will declare a cash dividend of NT$7 per share on Wednesday (the 16th), and the Fed and Taiwan’s central bank are expected to announce their latest rate decisions on Thursday (the 17th), which will also draw market focus.

Last week the Taiwan market ended a two‑week streak of weekly gains; despite a modest 0.79% decline, institutional investors remained supportive while foreign investors and proprietary traders were net sellers, putting pressure on the chip count.

Foreign investors’ major net‑selling last week included 98,000 shares of Compal (2324‑TW), 80,000 shares of Wistron (3231‑TW), nearly 70,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), over 58,000 shares of Taishin Shin Kong Financial (2887‑TW), more than 40,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Forward 2 (00631L‑TW), about 38,000 shares of Active CTBC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) and 30,000 shares of Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield (00919‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader noted that the CME FedWatch tool shows an 86% chance of a one‑point Fed hike this week, but Friday’s U.S. market did not reflect strong hike‑fear pressure because oil prices fell, and some market voices argue that U.S. inflation data are still insufficient to justify another hike.

Therefore, this week investors should watch for large swings in international oil prices. If the Fed does raise rates and the market perceives that the “rate‑hike cycle has arrived,” capital could flow back to the dollar, creating short‑term pull‑back pressure on the broader index.

Yongfeng Investment Advisory points out that the Taiwan market’s historic plateau around the 47,000‑point moving‑average band has been tangled; after breaking below it last Friday, the key question is whether the market can reclaim the level this week and whether volume expands. If volume continues to shrink to NT$600 billion, overall market liquidity will be thin, and a further rally will need additional positive catalysts.
Yongfeng also cautioned that the market will start watching whether oil‑price‑driven inflation is beginning to become entrenched over the long term.

items.title: imec突破High-NA EUV極限 光阻材料將一路延續至埃米世代
items.title_en: imec Breaks High-NA EUV Limits; Photoresist Materials Expected to Continue Through the A-Series Nodes
paras: 比利時微電子研究中心(imec)宣布攜手ASML及材料供應商，在High-NA EUV微影技術再取得進展。將產業沿用多年的化學放大阻劑(CAR)，完成22奈米間距導線的單次圖形化，並驗證多種接近實際晶片設計的複雜結構，顯示成熟CAR光阻技術有望延伸至A14、A10等埃米世代，應用於部分關鍵金屬層與通孔層。
隨著先進製程持續微縮，傳統0.33NA EUV在部分高密度層已逐步逼近單次曝光極限，未來若要製作更細線路，可能需要透過多重圖形化增加曝光與蝕刻次數。High-NA EUV則藉由提高數值孔徑，提升解析能力，目標是在更小尺寸下仍可維持單次曝光，降低製程複雜度及多次曝光帶來的對位誤差。
不過，曝光機解析度提升後，光阻材料是否能同步支援更細微圖形，一直是High-NA EUV量產的重要挑戰。化學放大阻劑是目前半導體業長期使用的成熟技術，具備穩定度高、供應鏈完整與量產經驗豐富等優勢，但過去業界普遍關注，其在極小尺寸下是否會面臨圖形粗糙、斷線或橋接等問題。
imec此次公布的成果顯示，經過材料與蝕刻製程共同優化後，CAR的微縮能力仍有進一步延伸空間。imec已利用High-NA EUV單次曝光，成功完成22奈米導線/間距圖形，較先前驗證的28奈米間距再進一步縮小。
除了規則性線路外，imec此次也將測試範圍擴展到更貼近實際邏輯晶片的複雜圖形，包括蛇形與叉形電性測試結構、SRAM布局、邏輯金屬佈線，以及28奈米中心間距的通孔結構，並取得良好的圖形保真度。
imec指出，相關成果顯示High-NA EUV搭配CAR，有機會應用在A14、A10邏輯節點的部分關鍵元件層，包括第二金屬層(M2)、通孔層，以及連接電晶體源極、汲極與第一金屬層的金屬擴散層。
事實上，imec先前已透過電性測試，驗證High-NA EUV搭配CAR可製作28奈米間距金屬線，並在長達1.8公尺的金屬化測試結構上取得具發展潛力的組合良率，證明相關技術不只停留在圖形成像階段，也具備進一步朝電性與量產驗證推進的潛力。
此次進一步將間距縮小至22奈米，也代表CAR突破過去0.33NA EUV單次圖形化被認為存在的微縮極限。相較全面更換新型光阻材料，若現有CAR平台可持續沿用，將有助降低High-NA EUV導入新材料與新製程的複雜度，並延續既有成熟供應鏈。
imec圖形化技術研究計畫研發副總Geert Vandenberghe表示，CAR是半導體產業沿用數十年的成熟技術，穩定性及可製造性均已經過長期驗證，最新研究結果顯示，CAR在High-NA EUV時代仍具有相當大的應用價值。
從產業角度來看，High-NA EUV真正的效益不僅在於能夠印出更小尺寸圖形，更在於有機會將原本需要兩次甚至多次曝光的關鍵製程，重新整合為單次圖形化。若能減少曝光、蝕刻與對位次數，可望降低製程複雜度與overlay誤差，並改善先進製程的製造效率。
paras_en: Belgian research institute imec announced a collaboration with ASML and material suppliers to achieve another milestone in High-NA EUV lithography, using the industry‑standard chemically amplified resist (CAR) to print 22 nm pitch lines in a single exposure and to validate a variety of complex structures that resemble real chip designs, indicating that mature CAR technology could extend to A14, A10 and other A‑series nodes for selected critical metal and via layers.

As advanced processes keep shrinking, conventional 0.33 NA EUV is approaching its single‑exposure limit on some high‑density layers, and future finer lines may require multiple patterning steps that increase exposure and etch cycles. High‑NA EUV raises the numerical aperture to improve resolution, aiming to keep single‑exposure printing at smaller dimensions, thereby reducing process complexity and alignment errors associated with multiple exposures.

However, once the scanner’s resolution is enhanced, whether the photoresist can keep up with finer patterns remains a key challenge for High‑NA EUV volume production. Chemically amplified resists are a long‑standing, mature technology in the semiconductor industry, offering high stability, a complete supply chain and extensive production experience, but the industry has traditionally worried about potential issues such as line roughness, breaks or bridges at extremely small dimensions.

imec’s new results show that, after co‑optimizing the resist and etch processes, CAR still has room to shrink further. Using High‑NA EUV single‑exposure, imec successfully printed 22 nm line/space patterns, a step beyond the previously demonstrated 28 nm pitch.

Beyond regular lines, imec also expanded testing to more realistic logic‑chip geometries, including serpentine and forked electrical test structures, SRAM layouts, logic metal routing, and 28 nm center‑to‑center via patterns, all of which achieved good pattern fidelity.

imec notes that these findings suggest High‑NA EUV combined with CAR could be used for key layers of the A14 and A10 logic nodes, such as the second metal layer (M2), via layers, and the metal diffusion layer that connects transistor source/drain to the first metal layer.

In fact, imec previously demonstrated through electrical testing that High‑NA EUV with CAR can fabricate 28 nm pitch metal lines and achieved promising combination yields on a 1.8‑meter‑long metallization test structure, proving the technology is moving beyond imaging to electrical and production validation.

Shrinking the pitch further to 22 nm this time shows that CAR can break the perceived shrink limit of 0.33 NA EUV single‑patterning. If the existing CAR platform can continue to be used instead of switching to entirely new resists, it will lower the complexity of introducing new materials and processes for High‑NA EUV while preserving the mature supply chain.

Geert Vandenberghe, vice‑president of imec’s lithography research program, said CAR has been a proven, decades‑old technology in the semiconductor industry, with stability and manufacturability validated over time, and the latest results demonstrate that CAR still holds significant value in the High‑NA EUV era.

From an industry perspective, the real benefit of High‑NA EUV lies not only in printing smaller features but also in the possibility of consolidating processes that previously required two or more exposures into a single patterning step. Reducing the number of exposures, etches and alignments can cut process complexity and overlay errors, improving manufacturing efficiency for advanced nodes.

items.title: 維田樂看市況能見度維持高檔 營運淡季不淡、旺季更旺
items.title_en: WeiTian Remains Optimistic as Market Visibility Stays High; Off‑Season Not Slow, Peak Season Even Stronger
paras: 工業電腦廠維田(6570-TW)表示，受惠Edge AI需求升溫、歐美專案拉貨力道強勁，對市況維持樂觀看法，下半年營運可望逐季增，淡季不淡、旺季更旺，預期全年營收挑戰新高、獲利也將重回成長。
維田表示，從目前需求來看，Edge AI相關領域的接單情況十分不錯，而智慧交通、智慧醫療等大型專案持續按照排程出貨，加上歐美市場訂單量、出貨量維持穩定，整體訂單能見度仍相當高。
維田進一步指出，公司近年布局高毛利產品，尤以不鏽鋼工業電腦產品線的成效最佳，毛利率貢獻高，產品銷售量也呈現穩定成長，公司對不鏽鋼產品線深具信心，對營運表現有非常大的助益。
維田NuTAM系列不鏽鋼工業電腦，具備IP66/IP69K整機防水防塵，抗紫外線日光可視觸控螢幕，可在寬溫嚴苛環境操作，具有Edge AI運算能力，適合食品製造、生技製藥、戶外場域等應用，
維田8月營收月1.04億元，雖然月減2.9%、但年增22.6%，累計前8月營收7.61億元，年增27.5%，創歷史同期新高。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker WeiTian (6570‑TW) said that rising demand for Edge AI and strong order pull from Europe and the United States keep its market outlook upbeat. It expects quarterly revenue growth in the second half, with the off‑season remaining robust and the peak season even stronger, targeting a new‑high full‑year revenue and a return to profit growth.

WeiTian noted that current demand for Edge AI‑related fields is very strong, and large projects in smart transportation and smart healthcare continue to ship on schedule. Combined with stable order and shipment volumes in Europe and the United States, overall order visibility remains high.

The company further pointed out that it has recently focused on high‑margin products, especially its stainless‑steel industrial computer line, which delivers the best gross‑margin contribution and shows steady sales growth. WeiTian is highly confident in the stainless‑steel line, which greatly supports its operating performance.

WeiTian’s NuTAM series stainless‑steel industrial computers feature IP66/IP69K full‑machine waterproof and dustproof protection, UV‑resistant sunlight‑visible touch screens, and can operate in wide‑temperature harsh environments. They also have Edge AI computing capability, making them suitable for food manufacturing, biotech/pharma, outdoor applications and more.

WeiTian posted August revenue of NT$104 million, down 2.9% month‑over‑month but up 22.6% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$761 million, a 27.5% year‑over‑year increase, setting a new historical high for the same period.

items.title: 百容購新廠建地本周完成交割 仍往需求強烈半導體應用擴張
items.title_en: BaiRong Completes New Factory Land Transfer This Week, Continues Strong Demand for Semiconductor Applications Expansion
paras: 百容 (2483-TW)擲3.23 億元購置台中工業區工一路702坪廠房及土地，預計在本周完成交割，這也是今年以來繼大立光 (3008-TW) 在台中工業區的提供生產用生產用不動產購置案。百容規劃將爲生產CPU散熱片生產新產能。
百容投資台中廠二期工程已經進入完工階段，二廠並並設置新研發中心；購置台中工業區新廠土地面積達 702 坪，預計將另投入資金購買設備及另重新與建廠房容納重型沖壓設備進駐，對於資金需求規劃，百容評估仍以有資金支應，目前暫無自市場進行籌資的規劃。
百容 2026 年第二季單季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，季增 17.62%，年增 20.42%，同時，在百容第二季在毛利率及營業利益同步走高，加上業外及匯率等有利因素挹注，百容所獲挹注上半年稅後純益將逾 4362萬元，每股純益達 0.4元。
百容 2026 年 7 月營收 2.01 億元，月增 1.75%，年增 37.19%，8月也在1.88億元的歷史高檔水準，且在產品結構上，對半導體應用業務仍維持於50%之上的水準；預估2026年第三季仍將維持第二季的營收水準 。
百容產品涵蓋半導體應用業業、電子零組件、步進馬達等，2026年以來半導體應用業務己登上營收50%之上，同時，對繼電器也朝耐高壓、大電流產品發展。
paras_en: BaiRong (2483-TW) spent NT$323 million to acquire a 702-ping factory and land on Gongyi Road in the Taichung Industrial Zone, with the transfer expected to be completed this week. This follows Largan Precision (3008-TW)’s acquisition of production‑use real estate in the same zone earlier this year. BaiRong plans to use the site to add new capacity for manufacturing CPU heat sinks.

The second‑phase project for BaiRong’s Taichung plant has entered the completion stage and will also house a new R&D center. The newly purchased land totals 702 ping, and the company intends to invest further funds to buy equipment and construct facilities capable of accommodating heavy‑press machines. Regarding financing, BaiRong assesses that it has sufficient internal funds and currently has no plans to raise capital from the market.

In Q2 2026, BaiRong recorded quarterly revenue of NT$566 million, a record high for the period, up 17.62% quarter‑over‑quarter and 20.42% year‑over‑year. Gross margin and operating profit both improved, and favorable non‑operating and exchange‑rate effects boosted the results. The company’s net profit after tax for the first half of the year is projected to exceed NT$43.62 million, or earnings of NT$0.40 per share.

In July 2026, BaiRong’s revenue reached NT$201 million, up 1.75% month‑over‑month and 37.19% year‑over‑year. August revenue remained at a historic high of NT$188 million, and the semiconductor‑application segment continues to account for over 50% of sales. The company expects Q3 2026 revenue to stay at the same level as Q2.

BaiRong’s product portfolio includes semiconductor‑application components, electronic parts, and stepper motors. Since 2026, semiconductor‑application sales have exceeded 50% of total revenue, and the firm is also expanding its relay business toward high‑voltage, high‑current products.

items.title: 中東戰火升溫油價飆破115美元！中油淚吞近2百億 明起汽、柴油各漲0.7元及0.6元
items.title_en: Middle East conflict heats up, oil prices surge past $115! CPC Corp swallows nearly NT$20 billion, gasoline and diesel to rise NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 starting tomorrow
paras: 中東地緣政治危機加劇，國際油價飆漲，即令台灣中油公司近7個月來已吞下近200億補貼，但仍擋不住漲勢。 台灣中油12日宣布，自明（14）日凌晨0時起至9月20日24時止，汽、柴油價格每公升將分別調漲0.7元及0.6元。調整後的參考零售價格分別為92無鉛汽油每公升31.2元、95無鉛汽油每公升32.7元、98無鉛汽油每公升34.7元、超級柴油每公升29.9元。
隨著中東戰事持續升溫，市場對原油供應與運輸風險的疑慮大幅增加，帶動國際油價急遽攀升。台灣中油表示，本周浮動油價調整指標7D3B（70%杜拜+30%北海布蘭特）周均價攀升至每桶115.61美元，較前周的99.82美元大漲15.79美元；雖然新台幣對美元匯率升值0.126元，但綜合評估後，依油價公式計算漲幅仍高達12.29%。

為照顧國內民生與平穩物價，政府及台灣中油持續啟動各項平穩機制。除了政府擴大貨物稅減徵，汽、柴油分別吸收3.7元及2.1元外，台灣中油為維持亞鄰最低價並持續執行美伊戰爭專案平穩機制，本周汽、柴油各再吸收6.8元及8.7元。合計汽、柴油每公升分別吸收高達10.5元及10.8元，大幅緩解國內物價通膨壓力。台灣中油統計，自今年2月28日至9月13日止，執行專案平穩各項措施累計吸收金額已達約198.5億元。
paras_en: The escalating geopolitical crisis in the Middle East has driven international oil prices sharply higher, forcing Taiwan’s CPC Corp to absorb nearly NT$20 billion in subsidies over the past seven months, yet it cannot stop the upward trend. CPC announced on the 12th that, effective from 00:00 on the 14th until 24:00 on September 20, gasoline and diesel prices will each increase by NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 per litre, respectively. After the adjustment, the reference retail prices will be NT$31.2 per litre for 92‑octane unleaded gasoline, NT$32.7 for 95‑octane, NT$34.7 for 98‑octane, and NT$29.9 for premium diesel.

As the Middle East war intensifies, market concerns over crude supply and transportation risks have surged, pushing international oil prices sharply upward. CPC reported that this week’s floating oil price adjustment index 7D3B (70% Dubai + 30% Brent) rose to a weekly average of $115.61 per barrel, up $15.79 from the previous week’s $99.82. Although the New Taiwan dollar appreciated by NT$0.126 against the US dollar, the calculated price increase based on the oil‑price formula still reaches 12.29%.

To protect domestic livelihoods and stabilize prices, the government and CPC continue to activate various stabilization mechanisms. In addition to the government’s expanded reduction of commodity taxes, CPC absorbs NT$3.7 per litre of gasoline and NT$2.1 per litre of diesel. Moreover, to maintain the lowest regional price and continue the US‑Iran war stabilization project, CPC absorbs an additional NT$6.8 per litre of gasoline and NT$8.7 per litre of diesel this week. In total, CPC absorbs up to NT$10.5 per litre of gasoline and NT$10.8 per litre of diesel, markedly easing domestic inflation pressure. CPC’s statistics show that from February 28 to September 13 this year, the cumulative amount absorbed through the stabilization measures totals approximately NT$19.85 billion.

items.title: 引資釋利多！財政部放寬促參公建門檻 勞工與文教設施享5年免營所稅
items.title_en: Attracting Capital, Boosting Benefits: Finance Ministry Lowers Thresholds for Private Participation in Public Projects, Granting 5‑Year Corporate Income Tax Exemption for Labor and Cultural Facilities
paras: 財政部於11日發布修正促進民間參與公共建設法之重大公共建設範圍，針對勞工福利設施及文教設施進行門檻放寬與增訂。本次修法主要為配合勞動部與文化部相關政策，期望藉由誘因吸引更多民間資金投入公共建設興建與營運，除了大幅提升對勞工服務之量能與品質外，也能進一步促進歷史建築與文化資產之永續營運及再利用。
本次重大範圍修正重點主要包含兩大面向。在勞工福利設施部分，增訂依促參法第8條第1項第1款新建營運移轉以及第2款新建無償移轉營運辦理之個案，只要投資總額不含土地達3億元以上之勞工育樂機構及其設施，即可納入重大公共建設範疇，引進民間活力挹注相關設施。
在文教設施部分，考量文化資產活化之特殊性，本次特別增訂投資總額不含土地達5000萬元以上之歷史建築、紀念建築、聚落建築群及文化景觀等設施，希望有效降低民間業者參與門檻，顯著提升民間企業參與文化資產保存、維護及經營管理之意願。

財政部指出，凡符合重大公共建設範圍之促參個案，民間機構將可獲得多項極具吸引力之稅賦優惠措施，包括享有5年免徵營利事業所得稅、投資支出之營利事業所得稅抵減、進口機具設備關稅優惠，以及地價稅、房屋稅與契稅減免，甚至包含股東投資抵減等好處。政府期盼經由本次促參重大範圍之彈性調整，能有效引導民間資金投入相關公共建設計畫，共同打造勞工福祉與文化資產保存雙贏之局面。有關本次修正之詳細規定與內容，民眾及業者可逕至財政部主管法規查詢系統進行深入了解。
paras_en: On the 11th, the Finance Ministry announced revisions to the scope of major public construction under the Act on Promoting Private Participation in Public Works, easing thresholds and adding provisions for labor‑welfare and cultural‑education facilities. The amendment aligns with policies of the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Culture, aiming to attract more private capital into the construction and operation of public projects, thereby greatly enhancing the capacity and quality of services for workers and further promoting the sustainable operation and reuse of historic buildings and cultural assets.

The key changes focus on two areas. For labor‑welfare facilities, the amendment adds new cases under Article 8, Paragraph 1, Items 1 and 2 of the Private Participation Act—newly built facilities transferred for operation and newly built facilities transferred free of charge for operation. Any labor recreation institution and its facilities with a total investment (excluding land) of NT$300 million or more will now be classified as major public construction, opening the door for private sector involvement.

For cultural‑education facilities, recognizing the special nature of cultural‑asset revitalization, the amendment specifically adds historic buildings, memorial structures, settlement clusters and cultural landscapes with total investment (excluding land) of NT$50 million or more. This aims to lower the entry barrier for private firms and significantly increase their willingness to participate in the preservation, maintenance and management of cultural assets.

The Finance Ministry noted that private entities participating in projects that fall within the revised major public‑construction scope will enjoy a suite of attractive tax incentives, including a five‑year exemption from corporate income tax, deductions for corporate income tax on investment expenditures, preferential import duties on machinery and equipment, and reductions or exemptions on land tax, house tax, deed tax, as well as shareholder investment deductions. The government hopes that these flexible adjustments will effectively channel private capital into relevant public‑construction plans, creating a win‑win situation for labor welfare and cultural‑asset preservation. Detailed regulations and provisions of the amendment can be consulted through the Finance Ministry’s regulatory database.

items.title: 台股Q4攻堅有靠山！法人力挺「AI+金融」雙引擎 高息ETF成避風港
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks’ Q4 Push Backed by Institutional Support! Institutions Favor “AI+Finance” Dual Engines, High‑Yield ETFs as Safe Havens
paras: 時序即將步入2026年第四季，台股大盤在歷經第三季高檔拉回洗牌後，整體多頭架構依然穩固。市場法人認為，在全球貨幣政策轉趨寬鬆與AI基礎建設需求熱絡的加持下，台股第四季將迎來傳統旺季與作帳行情。投資人在面對高檔震盪時，可透過布局兼具「AI成長動能」與「金融防禦高息」的高股息ETF，以定期定額或逢回加碼的策略穩健參與第四季攻堅行情。
大華優利高填息30(00918-TW)經理人郭修誠指出，全球金融市場流動性顯著改善，壓低企業資金成本，同時帶動外資回流亞太高成長市場。隨第四季進入傳統科技新品備貨與消費旺季，美系四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI基礎建設資本支出，供應鏈接單能見度已直通2027年。此外，次世代 AI PC 與智慧型手機普及率提升，亦帶動IC通路與消費電子板塊補漲。
非電族群方面，金融業受惠於前三季資本利得與手續費收入爆發，全年獲利有望創歷史新高；航運與重電基建則因運價支撐及全球轉型需求發揮防禦效果。郭修誠分析，00918配置呈現「電腦周邊與AI終端、金融保險、航運物流及電子通路」四足鼎立形態，交叉佈局「AI終端量產＋高息防禦＋基礎建設」，能有效發揮分散風險與提高組合填息率的效果，是高檔拉回時進行戰略性佈局的利器。
針對台股後市，國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)經理人江宇騰表示，台灣AI產業已從題材逐步轉化為實質訂單與企業獲利。財政部最新公布8月出口達824億美元，創歷年單月新高且連續34個月正成長，AI及高效能運算需求即為核心推手。金融業則受惠獲利強勁，國內13家金控前7月合計大賺4,927億元，基本面穩健並具高殖利率優勢。
00878整體配置約四成AI、三成金融，主要成分股涵蓋中信金、廣達、國泰金、富邦金、聯發科與光寶科等指標大廠，近1年報酬率高達80.83%，績效位居高股息ETF第一。國泰投信建議，面對台股高檔震盪，投資人可採取「定期定額、逢回加碼」雙軌策略，透過建立紀律投資機制與股息再投入，平均持有成本並發揮長期複利效果。
在市場波動加大之際，元大台灣高息低波(00713-TW) 的低波動特性備受法人肯定。法人分析，00713主要從台股中大型權值企業中，篩選高股利與低波動標的，統計至7月底，近三年年化波動度僅11.09%，持續居台灣大型股票基金之冠。

下半年以來截至9/11，台股大盤僅小漲0.13%，但00713卻逆勢大漲6.06%。表現勝過大盤的主因，在於上半年電子股漲幅較大後，00713持股自然轉向「電信、金融及內需消費」三大產業並重，例如華南金、永豐金、東和鋼鐵及遠傳、台灣大哥大等皆提供穩健撐盤力道。00713本季公告配息1.25元，將於9/21除息、10/13發放。法人指出，面對市場暴漲暴跌，投資人可將低波動ETF作為現金替代部位，平日領息增益，遭遇拉回時再適度加碼市值型或槓桿型ETF。

paras_en: The calendar is about to enter the fourth quarter of 2026, and after the high‑level pull‑back and reshuffling in Q3, the overall bullish structure of the Taiwan stock market remains solid. Institutional investors believe that with global monetary policy turning more accommodative and strong demand for AI infrastructure, Taiwan’s market will enjoy a traditional peak season and a “account‑closing” rally in Q4. When faced with high‑level volatility, investors can steadily participate in the Q4 push by allocating to high‑dividend ETFs that combine “AI growth momentum” with “financial defensive high yields,” using systematic‑investment or buy‑on‑dip strategies.

Dahua‑Uli’s high‑yield ETF 30 (00918‑TW) manager Guo Xiucheng noted that global financial market liquidity has improved markedly, lowering corporate financing costs and prompting foreign capital to flow back into high‑growth Asia‑Pacific markets. As Q4 brings the traditional tech product‑stock‑piling and consumer peak season, the four major U.S. cloud service providers continue to expand AI infrastructure capex, with supply‑chain order visibility extending to 2027. Moreover, the rising penetration of next‑generation AI PCs and smartphones is boosting IC distribution and consumer‑electronics sectors.

In non‑technology sectors, the financial industry benefits from a surge in capital‑gain and fee income in the first three quarters, positioning full‑year profit to hit a historic high; shipping and heavy‑electric infrastructure gain defensive strength from freight‑rate support and global transition demand. Guo explains that 00918’s allocation forms a “four‑leg” structure of computer peripherals & AI endpoints, financial insurance, shipping logistics, and electronic distribution, crossing “AI endpoint mass production + high‑yield defense + infrastructure.” This diversifies risk and raises the portfolio’s yield‑filling rate, making it a strategic tool for positioning during high‑level pull‑backs.

Regarding Taiwan’s market outlook, Jiang Yuteng, manager of the Cathay Sustainable High‑Dividend ETF (00878‑TW), said Taiwan’s AI industry has moved from a hype theme to real orders and corporate earnings. The Ministry of Finance recently reported August exports of US$82.4 billion, a record monthly high and 34 consecutive months of growth, driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand. The financial sector also benefits from strong earnings, with Taiwan’s 13 banking groups posting a combined profit of NT$492.7 billion in the first seven months, offering solid fundamentals and high dividend yields.

The 00878 fund is roughly 40% AI and 30% financials, with top holdings including CTBC Financial Holding, Quanta Computer, Cathay Financial Holding, Fubon Financial Holding, MediaTek and Lite‑On Technology, delivering a 1‑year return of 80.83%—the best performance among high‑dividend ETFs. Cathay Asset Management recommends that amid high‑level market swings, investors adopt a dual approach of systematic purchases and buying on dips, establishing disciplined investing and dividend reinvestment to lower average cost and harness long‑term compounding.

Amid heightened market volatility, the low‑volatility characteristic of Yuanta Taiwan High‑Yield Low‑Volatility ETF (00713‑TW) has earned strong institutional endorsement. Analysts note that 00713 selects high‑dividend, low‑volatility stocks from Taiwan’s large‑cap weightings; as of the end of July, its three‑year annualized volatility was only 11.09%, consistently the lowest among Taiwan’s large‑cap stock funds.

Since the second half of the year up to September 11, the Taiwan market index has risen a modest 0.13%, while 00713 surged 6.06% against the trend. The outperformance stems from a shift after a strong first‑half rally in electronics toward a balanced exposure to telecom, finance and domestic consumption, with holdings such as Hua Nan Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Donghe Steel, Far EasTone and Taiwan Mobile providing solid support. 00713 announced a quarterly dividend of NT$1.25, ex‑dividend on September 21 and payable on October 13. Institutions suggest that in volatile markets, investors can use low‑volatility ETFs as a cash‑substitute, collect regular income, and add to market‑cap or leveraged ETFs on pull‑backs.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone 18系列與首款摺疊機亮相 台灣手機通路全力備戰預購潮
items.title_en: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Series and First Foldable Phone, Taiwan Retailers Gear Up for Pre‑order Surge
paras: 蘋果正式推出年度旗艦iPhone 18 Pro系列與首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo，台灣各大手機通路商於全面展開預購備戰行動。包含神腦(2450-TW)、燦坤(2430-TW)等業者，啟動線上線下預約機制，藉由信用卡現折、配件加碼以及舊換新補貼等多元配套，力抗零組件成本上漲帶來的終端價格壓力，全力搶攻下半年傳統消費電子換機大潮。
研調機構TrendForce預估，2026年全球摺疊手機出貨量約2020萬支，年增0.5%。其中蘋果iPhone Duo全年度出貨量預計達約500萬支，有望一舉拿下摺疊市場24.8%的市占率，緊追三星的35.1%與華為的24.8%。
研調機構Counterpoint Research進一步指出，受惠於A20 Pro晶片效能升級與強大的既有用戶基礎，iPhone 18 Pro系列對使用3至4年前舊機種的數百萬用戶具備高度升級誘因，加上iPhone Duo定價落在1999美元且未突破2000美元大關，皆有助於刺激初期高階換機需求。
神腦國際宣布於9月12日晚間8時起在線上商城開放iPhone 18 Pro系列預購，祭出全系列機型3%神腦幣無上限回饋，並鎖定10月23日正式開賣的摺疊機iPhone Duo提前卡位。針對換機週期拉長且暫不購置新機的消費族群，採取新機搭售與舊機升級雙軌策略鞏固客戶基礎。
燦坤則宣布，將於9月12日晚間8時在官方線上購物開放iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max預購，並保證9月18日開賣首日即可至全台100家門市取貨，並透露門市現場以新色勃根地紅詢問度最高。
連鎖通訊通路傑昇通信則推出預約抽獎與配件3折優惠，並針對下架的iPhone 17 Pro系列空機擴大降價近4000元出清，同時聯手安卓陣營祭出熱銷旗艦折扣，正面迎戰新機漲勢。
受到全球供應鏈成本與關鍵零組件價格顯著上揚影響，新旗艦機價格面臨調整壓力，前代iPhone 17系列售價同步漲幅超過1成。在量縮價漲的市場氛圍下，通路商轉向藉由分期零利率、高額配件搭售金與延長保固維修等周邊服務，積極降低消費者的換機門檻，並透過提高平均客單價與服務附加價值，全力支撐下半年旺季的整體營運動能。
paras_en: Apple officially launched its annual flagship iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, prompting major Taiwanese mobile retailers to roll out full‑scale pre‑order campaigns. Companies such as Shin Kong (2450‑TW) and Tsann Kuen (2430‑TW) have activated both online and offline reservation systems, offering credit‑card cash‑back, accessory bundles and trade‑in subsidies to counteract the price pressure from rising component costs and to capture the second‑half consumer‑electronics upgrade wave.

Research firm TrendForce estimates global foldable‑phone shipments will reach about 20.2 million units in 2026, a 0.5% year‑over‑year increase. Apple’s iPhone Duo is projected to ship roughly 5 million units for the full year, potentially securing a 24.8% share of the foldable market, closely trailing Samsung’s 35.1% and Huawei’s 24.8%.

Counterpoint Research adds that the A20 Pro chip’s performance boost and Apple’s massive existing user base give the iPhone 18 Pro series a strong upgrade incentive for the millions of users still on devices three to four years old. The iPhone Duo’s price of $1,999—just under the $2,000 mark—should also help drive early high‑end replacement demand.

Shin Kong International announced that starting at 8 p.m. on September 12 it will open pre‑orders for the iPhone 18 Pro series on its online mall, offering an unlimited 3% Shin Kong Coin rebate on all models and reserving the foldable iPhone Duo for early purchase ahead of its official launch on October 23. For customers whose upgrade cycles are longer or who are not yet buying a new phone, the retailer will employ a dual strategy of bundling new devices with trade‑in upgrades to solidify its customer base.

Tsann Kuen said it will open pre‑orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max at 8 p.m. on September 12 via its official online store, guaranteeing that customers can pick up their phones at any of its 100 stores nationwide on the first day of sales, September 18, and noted that the new Burgundy Red color is generating the highest in‑store interest.

Jie Sheng Communications, a chain telecom retailer, launched a reservation lottery and a 30% discount on accessories, while slashing the price of discontinued iPhone 17 Pro bare units by nearly NT$4,000. It also teamed up with Android brands to offer hot‑selling flagship discounts, directly confronting the price hikes of the new models.

Because global supply‑chain costs and key component prices have risen sharply, the new flagship’s pricing faces upward pressure, with the previous‑generation iPhone 17 series seeing price increases of over 10%. In a market of shrinking volumes and rising prices, retailers are turning to zero‑interest installment plans, high‑value accessory bundles, and extended warranty services to lower the barrier for consumers to upgrade, while boosting average transaction value and service‑related revenue to sustain overall operational momentum for the busy second half of the year.

items.title: imec突破High-NA EUV極限 光阻材料將一路延續至埃米世代
items.title_en: imec Breaks High-NA EUV Limits; Photoresist Materials Expected to Continue Through the A-Series Nodes
paras: 比利時微電子研究中心(imec)宣布攜手ASML及材料供應商，在High-NA EUV微影技術再取得進展。將產業沿用多年的化學放大阻劑(CAR)，完成22奈米間距導線的單次圖形化，並驗證多種接近實際晶片設計的複雜結構，顯示成熟CAR光阻技術有望延伸至A14、A10等埃米世代，應用於部分關鍵金屬層與通孔層。
隨著先進製程持續微縮，傳統0.33NA EUV在部分高密度層已逐步逼近單次曝光極限，未來若要製作更細線路，可能需要透過多重圖形化增加曝光與蝕刻次數。High-NA EUV則藉由提高數值孔徑，提升解析能力，目標是在更小尺寸下仍可維持單次曝光，降低製程複雜度及多次曝光帶來的對位誤差。
不過，曝光機解析度提升後，光阻材料是否能同步支援更細微圖形，一直是High-NA EUV量產的重要挑戰。化學放大阻劑是目前半導體業長期使用的成熟技術，具備穩定度高、供應鏈完整與量產經驗豐富等優勢，但過去業界普遍關注，其在極小尺寸下是否會面臨圖形粗糙、斷線或橋接等問題。
imec此次公布的成果顯示，經過材料與蝕刻製程共同優化後，CAR的微縮能力仍有進一步延伸空間。imec已利用High-NA EUV單次曝光，成功完成22奈米導線/間距圖形，較先前驗證的28奈米間距再進一步縮小。
除了規則性線路外，imec此次也將測試範圍擴展到更貼近實際邏輯晶片的複雜圖形，包括蛇形與叉形電性測試結構、SRAM布局、邏輯金屬佈線，以及28奈米中心間距的通孔結構，並取得良好的圖形保真度。
imec指出，相關成果顯示High-NA EUV搭配CAR，有機會應用在A14、A10邏輯節點的部分關鍵元件層，包括第二金屬層(M2)、通孔層，以及連接電晶體源極、汲極與第一金屬層的金屬擴散層。
事實上，imec先前已透過電性測試，驗證High-NA EUV搭配CAR可製作28奈米間距金屬線，並在長達1.8公尺的金屬化測試結構上取得具發展潛力的組合良率，證明相關技術不只停留在圖形成像階段，也具備進一步朝電性與量產驗證推進的潛力。
此次進一步將間距縮小至22奈米，也代表CAR突破過去0.33NA EUV單次圖形化被認為存在的微縮極限。相較全面更換新型光阻材料，若現有CAR平台可持續沿用，將有助降低High-NA EUV導入新材料與新製程的複雜度，並延續既有成熟供應鏈。
imec圖形化技術研究計畫研發副總Geert Vandenberghe表示，CAR是半導體產業沿用數十年的成熟技術，穩定性及可製造性均已經過長期驗證，最新研究結果顯示，CAR在High-NA EUV時代仍具有相當大的應用價值。
從產業角度來看，High-NA EUV真正的效益不僅在於能夠印出更小尺寸圖形，更在於有機會將原本需要兩次甚至多次曝光的關鍵製程，重新整合為單次圖形化。若能減少曝光、蝕刻與對位次數，可望降低製程複雜度與overlay誤差，並改善先進製程的製造效率。
paras_en: Belgian research institute imec announced a collaboration with ASML and material suppliers to achieve another milestone in High-NA EUV lithography, using the industry‑standard chemically amplified resist (CAR) to print 22 nm pitch lines in a single exposure and to validate a variety of complex structures that resemble real chip designs, indicating that mature CAR technology could extend to A14, A10 and other A‑series nodes for selected critical metal and via layers.

As advanced processes keep shrinking, conventional 0.33 NA EUV is approaching its single‑exposure limit on some high‑density layers, and future finer lines may require multiple patterning steps that increase exposure and etch cycles. High‑NA EUV raises the numerical aperture to improve resolution, aiming to keep single‑exposure printing at smaller dimensions, thereby reducing process complexity and alignment errors associated with multiple exposures.

However, once the scanner’s resolution is enhanced, whether the photoresist can keep up with finer patterns remains a key challenge for High‑NA EUV volume production. Chemically amplified resists are a long‑standing, mature technology in the semiconductor industry, offering high stability, a complete supply chain and extensive production experience, but the industry has traditionally worried about potential issues such as line roughness, breaks or bridges at extremely small dimensions.

imec’s new results show that, after co‑optimizing the resist and etch processes, CAR still has room to shrink further. Using High‑NA EUV single‑exposure, imec successfully printed 22 nm line/space patterns, a step beyond the previously demonstrated 28 nm pitch.

Beyond regular lines, imec also expanded testing to more realistic logic‑chip geometries, including serpentine and forked electrical test structures, SRAM layouts, logic metal routing, and 28 nm center‑to‑center via patterns, all of which achieved good pattern fidelity.

imec notes that these findings suggest High‑NA EUV combined with CAR could be used for key layers of the A14 and A10 logic nodes, such as the second metal layer (M2), via layers, and the metal diffusion layer that connects transistor source/drain to the first metal layer.

In fact, imec previously demonstrated through electrical testing that High‑NA EUV with CAR can fabricate 28 nm pitch metal lines and achieved promising combination yields on a 1.8‑meter‑long metallization test structure, proving the technology is moving beyond imaging to electrical and production validation.

Shrinking the pitch further to 22 nm this time shows that CAR can break the perceived shrink limit of 0.33 NA EUV single‑patterning. If the existing CAR platform can continue to be used instead of switching to entirely new resists, it will lower the complexity of introducing new materials and processes for High‑NA EUV while preserving the mature supply chain.

Geert Vandenberghe, vice‑president of imec’s lithography research program, said CAR has been a proven, decades‑old technology in the semiconductor industry, with stability and manufacturability validated over time, and the latest results demonstrate that CAR still holds significant value in the High‑NA EUV era.

From an industry perspective, the real benefit of High‑NA EUV lies not only in printing smaller features but also in the possibility of consolidating processes that previously required two or more exposures into a single patterning step. Reducing the number of exposures, etches and alignments can cut process complexity and overlay errors, improving manufacturing efficiency for advanced nodes.

items.title: 投資人對美債殖利率上升容忍度超過5％？《彭博》調查：破6%才會調整投資
items.title_en: Investors Tolerate Over 5% Rise in U.S. Treasury Yields? Bloomberg Survey: Adjustments Only After 6%
paras: 美國公債殖利率近期持續走高，10年期美債殖利率一度逼近5%大關，但《彭博》最新調查顯示，市場參與者對利率進一步上升仍具有相當程度的容忍度，多數受訪交易員認為，殖利率必須升至6%以上，才可能真正促使他們大幅調整個人投資組合。
週五（11日），油價回落帶動長天期美債殖利率小幅走低，但本週美債殖利率曲線整體明顯上揚。
其中，2年期美債殖利率本週大漲28個基點，升至4.60%以上；10年期殖利率一度觸及4.988%，逼近5%心理關卡；30年期美債殖利率則升至約5.38%，創2007年以來新高。

逾半受訪者認為殖利率需升至6%至8.24%才會調整持股

值得注意的是，《彭博》週五公布最新 Markets Pulse 調查，結果顯示，約5分之1受訪者表示，只有當10年期美債殖利率略高於6%，才會觸發個人投資組合的警戒，進而促使他們減持股票。
該調查於9月8日至10日進行，共收集122份有效回覆。
整體而言，受訪者回答的中位數為6.5%，其中以6%至6.24%區間獲得最多票數。此外，超過半數受訪者認為，10年期美債殖利率必須升至6%至8.24%之間，才會對個人持股進行實質調整。
這項結果與交易員對整體市場的看法形成明顯差異，也顯示投資人實際調整自身資產配置的門檻，可能高於市場對股市風險的普遍判斷。
調查進一步顯示，當問題轉向「10年期美債殖利率升至何種水準，可能導致標普500指數下跌10%」時，超過四分之三的受訪者認為臨界區間落在5%至5.75%。
然而，當同一問題改為詢問個人投資組合時，受訪者的容忍門檻明顯提高，中位數達到6.5%。
《彭博》調查指出，這種差異可能與機構及個人投資者所承擔的風險機制不同有關。機構投資人管理的是他人資產，通常面臨更大的績效問責壓力。
相較之下，個人在管理自身資金時，並沒有因投資決策錯誤而遭解雇的顧慮，因此可能願意承受更高風險。
值得注意的是，本次調查受訪者中，散戶投資者僅占7%。

殖利率上升速度可能比絕對水準更關鍵

《彭博》分析師 Tatiana Darie 此前指出，對金融市場而言，美債殖利率上升的速度可能比最終達到的絕對水準更具衝擊力，而此次 Markets Pulse 調查結果也反映出市場對不同利率情境的承受程度。
調查中，認為10年期美債殖利率必須升至10.5%以上才會採取行動的受訪者共有8人，並被單獨歸入一個區間。
這項分布顯示，部分市場參與者對極端利率情境仍保有相當大的容忍空間。換言之，若殖利率在短時間內快速攀升，即使尚未突破部分投資人的絕對警戒線，市場仍可能面臨較大的衝擊。
10年期美債殖利率在最新CPI數據公布後，已從5%附近回落，短線壓力暫時有所緩解。不過，若殖利率重新走高並快速逼近6%，可能觸發更多個人投資人調整持股，進一步增加股市下行壓力。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have been climbing recently, with the 10-year yield briefly approaching the 5% mark, but Bloomberg's latest survey shows market participants still have a considerable tolerance for further rate hikes. Most surveyed traders say yields would need to rise above 6% before they would make substantial adjustments to their personal portfolios.
On Friday (the 11th), falling oil prices nudged long‑term Treasury yields slightly lower, yet the overall yield curve has risen noticeably this week.

The 2-year Treasury yield jumped 28 basis points this week, climbing above 4.60%; the 10-year yield briefly hit 4.988%, edging close to the psychological 5% barrier; and the 30-year yield rose to about 5.38%, a high not seen since 2007.

More than half of respondents said yields would need to reach 6%‑8.24% before they would adjust their holdings. Notably, Bloomberg released its latest Markets Pulse survey on Friday, showing that roughly one‑fifth of those surveyed would only trigger a personal portfolio alert—and start cutting stocks—when the 10-year Treasury yield is just above 6%.
The survey was conducted from September 8‑10 and collected 122 valid responses.

Overall, the median response was 6.5%, with the 6%‑6.24% band receiving the most votes. Moreover, over half of respondents believe the 10-year Treasury yield must rise to between 6% and 8.24% before they would make substantive changes to their equity positions.

This result contrasts sharply with traders’ views of the broader market and suggests that investors’ actual thresholds for rebalancing may be higher than the market’s general assessment of equity‑risk levels.
When the question shifted to “At what 10‑year Treasury yield level might the S&P 500 fall 10%?” more than three‑quarters of respondents placed the critical range at 5%‑5.75%.
However, when the same question was framed around personal portfolios, respondents’ tolerance threshold rose markedly, with the median climbing to 6.5%.

Bloomberg notes this gap may stem from differing risk mechanisms for institutional versus individual investors. Institutional managers handle others’ assets and face greater performance‑accountability pressure.
In contrast, individuals managing their own money don’t risk being fired for a bad call, so they may be willing to shoulder higher risk.
It is worth noting that retail investors made up only 7% of the survey’s respondents.

Yield‑rise speed may matter more than absolute levels. Bloomberg analyst Tatiana Darie previously warned that the pace of Treasury yield increases can be more disruptive to financial markets than the ultimate level reached, and the Markets Pulse results reflect varying tolerance across rate scenarios.
Only eight respondents said they would act only if the 10‑year Treasury yield exceeded 10.5%, and they were grouped into a separate band.

This distribution shows that some market participants retain substantial tolerance for extreme rate environments. In other words, a rapid short‑term surge in yields could shock the market even if it hasn’t crossed many investors’ absolute alert thresholds.

After the latest CPI data, the 10‑year Treasury yield slipped from around 5%, easing short‑term pressure. Yet if yields climb back toward 6% quickly, more individual investors may rebalance, adding further downside pressure to equities.

items.title: 甲骨文擴大原定裁員規模！成本升至28億美元、AI資料中心太燒錢
items.title_en: Oracle Expands Original Layoff Plan as Costs Rise to $2.8 Billion; AI Data Centers Prove Expensive
paras: 甲骨文(ORCL-US) 在公司因大規模人工智慧（AI）資料中心開發計畫而面臨資金吃緊之際，進一步擴大原定裁員規模。公司最新監管文件顯示，這波裁員及重整計畫的預估成本已提高至約28億美元，主要用於支付遭裁員工的離職金。
根據《彭博》報導，根據監管文件，甲骨文裁員所產生的成本目前估計約為28億美元，公司將這項措施列為「2026年重整計畫」。這筆成本主要包括支付給遭解雇員工的離職金。
甲骨文表示，公司目前已針對該計畫累計認列約21億美元成本，而增加的7億美元反映「我們預期將採取的額外措施」。
甲骨文目前面臨財務壓力，原因在於為 OpenAI 等客戶大舉建置 AI 資料中心，需要投入龐大資金。《彭博》稍早報導，甲骨文今年初已開始裁減數千名員工，以節省現金。
《Business Insider》上月亦報導，公司正擬定新一輪裁員計畫。
甲骨文財務長Hilary Maxson週四（10日）與分析師進行電話會議時表示，「簡化與效率提升措施」有助於公司降低成本並守住利潤率。截至5月底，甲骨文在美國約有4.9萬名員工，海外員工則約9.2萬人，較一年前減少2.1萬名員工。
此外，甲骨文亦同時揭露董事長艾里森（Larry Ellison）的新股票交易計畫。艾里森持有甲骨文約40%的股份。
甲骨文在監管文件中表示，該計畫於6月22日採用，允許艾里森在10月24日前出售5000萬股股票。
甲骨文股價6月22日收在每股175.07美元，5000萬股的價值相當於87.5億美元；截至週五（11日）收盤，股價自當時以來已下跌16%。
艾里森一直是其子大衛・艾里森（David Ellison）去年收購派拉蒙全球(PARA-US) ，以及大衛・艾里森旗下 Paramount Skydance (PSKY-US) 以1100億美元收購華納兄弟探索(WBD-US) 計畫的重要資金支持者。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Oracle (ORCL-US) is further expanding its originally planned layoff scale as the company faces cash strain from a massive artificial‑intelligence (AI) data‑center development program. The latest regulatory filing shows the estimated cost of this wave of layoffs and restructuring has risen to roughly $2.8 billion, primarily to cover severance for the displaced workers.

According to Bloomberg, the regulatory filing estimates the cost of Oracle’s layoffs at about $2.8 billion, which the company has classified as a “2026 restructuring plan.” The expense mainly consists of severance payments to employees who are being let go.
Oracle said it has already recognized about $2.1 billion of the cost for the plan, and the additional $700 million reflects “additional measures we expect to take.”

Oracle is under financial pressure because it is pouring huge capital into building AI data centers for customers such as OpenAI. Bloomberg earlier reported that Oracle began cutting thousands of jobs earlier this year to conserve cash.
Business Insider reported last month that the company is drafting a new round of layoff plans.

Chief Financial Officer Hilary Maxson told analysts on a Thursday (the 10th) conference call that “simplification and efficiency‑enhancing measures” will help lower costs and protect margins. As of the end of May, Oracle employed about 49,000 people in the United States and roughly 92,000 overseas, down 21,000 from a year earlier.
The filing also disclosed a new stock‑sale plan for Chairman Larry Ellison, who owns about 40% of Oracle.
Oracle’s regulatory filing states the plan, adopted on June 22, permits Ellison to sell up to 50 million shares by October 24.
Oracle’s shares closed at $175.07 on June 22, making the 50 million‑share sale worth about $8.75 billion; by Friday the 11th the stock had fallen 16% from that level.

Ellison has been a key financial backer of his son David Ellison’s acquisition of Paramount Global (PARA‑US) last year and of David’s Paramount Skydance (PSKY‑US) plan to buy Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD‑US) for $110 billion.
